name: Shinozaki Futaba
source: Hazuki's sister and their homeroom teacher. She is very spacey and doesn't seem to be paying attention to anything around her. She is infatuated with Reiji's father, since he was so kind and supportive of her and Hazuki after their parents' deaths.
